title: Structure Learning in Bayesian Networks: A Systematic Pedagogical Survey
content: We systematically screened 3,988 retrieved papers on structure learning for Bayesian networks (BNs) and structural causal models (SCMs), excluding temporal/dynamic BNs; 656 studies met our inclusion criteria. Rather than forcing methods into a few classical bins, we present an idea-centered map of the field that covers constraint-based, score-based, and hybrid families alongside newer paradigms such as distributed/federated and privacy-preserving learning. For 85 foundational algorithms, we provide step-by-step pedagogical reconstructions with minimal toy examples, visuals, and companion slide decks. The result is a learning-oriented reference focused on core mechanisms, not benchmarks.
